fixed.summary: The refusal of a scene whose entity name is taken no longer advises "instantiate the scene under a root", which does not help: names are unique in the world, under any root. It now names what works: despawn the entity that has the name, rename it in the scene, or make what is placed more than once a prefab (og.load.prefab spawns its entities unnamed). A name used twice inside one scene is reported as that.
